parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the toaster's front panel, typically used to control specific functions such as cancel or reheat.
parts.Functional_description: This button activates or deactivates a specific function of the toaster when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic slider lever on the toaster's side used to lower bread slices into the heating slots.
parts.Functional_description: It engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting process and hold the bread in place.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward automatically after toasting.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another control button on the toaster, likely used for setting browning level or defrost function.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to select or adjust a specific toasting mode.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A smaller button on the toaster, possibly for a secondary function such as bagel mode or quick cancel.
parts.Functional_description: It triggers a specific function when pressed, such as stopping the toasting cycle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns outward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster, made of stainless steel, housing all internal components and providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, electrical components, and provides insulation and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural frame for all other parts.
